param: B Constant influx/recruitment rate of susceptible human hosts (boundary condition Sh(0,t)=B in original unnormalized system; in normalized system sh(0,t)=1).
μₕ Natural death rate of human hosts.
μᵥ Natural death rate of mosquitoes.
βₕ(a) Age-specific transmission/contact rate from infected mosquitoes to susceptible humans.
βᵥ(a) Age-specific transmission rate from infectious humans (symptomatic and asymptomatic) to susceptible mosquitoes.
k(a) Age-specific progression rate from exposed to infectious (latent period is 1/k(a)).
γ₁(a) Age-specific recovery rate of symptomatic infectious humans.
γ₂(a) Age-specific recovery rate of asymptomatic infectious humans.
ρ Probability an exposed human becomes symptomatic infectious (fraction ρ; remaining 1-ρ become asymptomatic).
σ Factor characterizing intensity of reinfection/secondary infection of asymptomatic infectious hosts; also scales asymptomatic contribution to mosquito infection in the paper.
Nₕ(t) Total human population size at time t (used in standard incidence terms in system (2.1)).
Nₕ* Limiting/steady total human population size used in normalized system (2.2) (denoted N*h in the paper).
